svg.font-family: Work Sans, Mulish, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: Map of business-address providers in and around Antibes
svg.desc: Map of Antibes, Vallauris, Biot, Valbonne, Villeneuve-Loubet and Cagnes-sur-Mer showing the five areas where the fifteen compared business-address providers are located. Alatere doMo, at 9 boulevard Albert 1er in central Antibes, is marked with its logo.
svg.text: Base map: French commune boundaries, IGN / Etalab
Reading monograms only: no third-party logos
